question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Table, Wood, Steel
solution:
**Given: **Table, Wood, Steel

The least possible venn diagram of the given statement is:

Option 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1caf7bcf38459a2c72cc94ea6554bf4589c5f317961d031a55ac2df0bd7a1e99.png] 

It shows that tables can be made of wood and tables can be made of steel (overlaps), while wood and steel themselves are distinct materials (no direct overlap between wood and steel circles).
